scope: Coverage diagnosis of the 1449 adopted NNG entries in the fixed evaluation references; no model or analyzer changes.
method: Count exact word/NNG forms in each gold sentence, then compare their per-sentence multiset presence in Node/WASM outputs. Not span-sensitive and not full-sentence F1. Substring counts use longest-first non-overlapping matches and do not assert morphological boundaries.
normalization: Gold as stored; spoken load_sx feed text and reverse_convert labels; texts stripped identically for Node. NNG target count is unaffected by EP normalization.
interpretation: Few new entries have a matching exact-NNG target in the fixed references, and some were already recognized without explicit FST entries. This explains limited direct coverage gain; it neither proves no benefit outside these sets nor measures generalization on unseen new-word contexts.
